images.caption: Stone Mountain Depot circa 1860, Stone Mountain, Georgia.  This photo is believed to have been taken about 1860.  The photo shows the western face of the building. The south side of the depot was built in 1857 shortly after the Georgia Railroad Company completed the line from Madison to Atlanta. The building is located at 922 Main Street, Stone Mountain, Georgia, USA. [1]

images.caption:
ARC10170/AR62  ALASKA
Exercise Great Bear
Pvt. William F. Lansford from Stone Mountain, Georgia, USARAL Signal Company, stringing cables through the trees for communication between Mohawk CP and Fort Richardson.
8 Feb 62
Photo by Sp4 Paul DeNucce
USARAL Spt Cmd Photo Facility
Fort Richardson
AT465

Exercise Great Bear (1961-62) was a large-scale Cold War-era joint operational force-on-force military winter maneuver in Alaska, and was significant because it marked the first time in 13 years that Canadian troops had maneuvered in Alaska. It incorporated an interoperability concept with integrated conventional and Special Forces components in an austere environment.
